title: PerilStructure
description: Declarative composition of per-peril models into a Risk Premium. What a Rating Version references, rather than a scatter of individual models (02 FR-MODEL-58..61, §4.10).
$comment: Amended 2026-08-22 (W5, the contract-reconciliation slice). Five resolutions, each the code's (CLAUDE.md §0): (1) every optional model reference and large-loss field is nullable, which they are on the type and were not here — the eight of them were invisible until the type comparison learned to read `null`; (2) `evidence_blob` is a BlobRef, not a string, the same defect `model.covariance_blob` and `transparency-artifact.relativity_table_blob` carried; (3) `flat_loading_minor` is deleted for `loading_factor` — a minor-unit amount and an exact-decimal multiplier are different quantities, and `LargeLossTreatment` has only ever had the second; (4) the reconciliation carries its per-peril breakdown and `computed_at`, which FR-MODEL-74 puts each treatment's number beside its treatment and §4.10's amendment records as new; (5) `excluded_perils` and `reconciliation` leave `required` — both are defaulted on the type, and `_coherent` requires the reconciliation only from `reconciled` onward. `ratio` and `status` stay declared and required here although the generated counterpart omits them: they are `computed_field`s, so they ARE on the wire, and `generate-contracts.py` emits the validation schema, which by construction cannot show them. NOT a divergence — see §4.10's 2026-08-18 note. Amended 2026-08-26 (W6b-15): `observed_burning_cost_minor` and `modelled_burning_cost_minor` drop the `_minor` suffix — `observed_burning_cost`, `modelled_burning_cost` — types unchanged, per OQ-OVR-12 (b) under FR-OVR-20; the names now match the generated side.

large_loss.description: Whatever is chosen is recorded with its calibration evidence (FR-MODEL-59).

restoration_loading.description: Exact decimal string; the model enforces >= 1 (a restoration loading below 1 would shrink the mean it exists to restore).

loading_factor.description: Exact decimal string; the flat_loading multiplier.

evidence_blob.description: FR-MODEL-59's calibration evidence, required for every kind that has something to calibrate — which is every kind but `none`.

excluded_perils.description: Every peril in the dataset is either modelled or explicitly excluded with a reason (FR-MODEL-60).

reason.description: Non-blank: an exclusion whose reason is whitespace satisfies the requirement's letter and none of its purpose.

reconciliation.description: FR-MODEL-60's persisted coherence check and FR-MODEL-74's treatment statement. Null until the structure is reconciled; required from `reconciled` onward, where it is the evidence the approval policy names.

part.description: UNRECONCILED (W5, 2026-08-22): this contract has always declared `train | holdout | full` and `Reconciliation.part` is an unconstrained non-empty `str`. Widened here so the published contract does not promise a constraint nothing enforces; whether the type should close instead is a CLAUDE.md §0 question.

perils.description: FR-MODEL-74's per-peril breakdown: each peril's contribution to the modelled total, beside the large-loss treatment that produced it. The total is checked to be the sum of these figures — a total that is not the sum is a third number nobody can source.

modelled_burning_cost.description: After restoration: a capped model reconciled against uncapped observed data without restoring its mean looks like a modelling error rather than an intended adjustment (FR-MODEL-74).

ratio.description: DERIVED, never stored — modelled over observed, quantised to six places. A `computed_field`, so it is on the wire and any incoming value is dropped and recomputed rather than refused. It is absent from the generated counterpart because `generate-contracts.py` emits the validation schema, which cannot show a computed field; that is a property of the generator, not a divergence.

tolerance.description: Declared fractional tolerance on |ratio - 1| (FR-MODEL-60). Exact decimal string, > 0.

status.description: DERIVED from |ratio - 1| against `tolerance`, on the same terms as `ratio` above.

PerilCode.description: A peril's code, upper-case and underscore-separated (`PerilCode`).

invariants: each peril appears at most once in perils, and at most once in excluded_perils (FR-MODEL-58)
no peril is both modelled and excluded — being both leaves the reader unable to say whether its cost is in the total (FR-MODEL-60)
status in {reconciled, review, approved} implies reconciliation is set (FR-MODEL-60/61)
modelled_burning_cost equals the sum of reconciliation.perils[].modelled_burning_cost, each rounded to minor units first (FR-MODEL-74)
